settings.quote: Skincare shouldn't need a chemistry degree to understand — or twelve steps to work.
settings.author: The Thessvane Team

settings.label: The business
settings.question: Who is behind Thessvane?
settings.answer: We're a small team that got tired of twelve-step routines and ingredient lists nobody can read. Thessvane is what we wanted for our own bathroom shelves: a handful of clean, well-made formulas that do the job without the theatre.

settings.label: The business
settings.question: What actually makes your products different?
settings.answer: Naturally derived actives, no synthetic fragrance, sulfates, or filler, and a routine built around three steps instead of twelve. Every formula is made in small batches and dermatologist tested before it ships.

settings.label: The business
settings.question: Are your products cruelty-free and vegan?
settings.answer: Yes. We don't test on animals, we don't work with suppliers who do, and every formula in the range is vegan.

settings.label: Your skin
settings.question: Will this work if my skin is sensitive or reactive?
settings.answer: Our formulas are fragrance-free and dermatologist tested with sensitive skin in mind. Skin is personal, though, so patch test on your inner arm for 24 hours before your first full use, and introduce one new product at a time.

settings.label: Your skin
settings.question: How long before I see a difference?
settings.answer: Most people notice softer, better-hydrated skin within the first two weeks. Changes in tone and texture take a full skin cycle — give it six to eight weeks of consistent use before you judge the results.

settings.label: Buying with us
settings.question: What if it isn't right for me?
settings.answer: Contact us within 30 days and we'll sort out a return or exchange. If something reacted badly with your skin, tell us what happened — that feedback shapes the next formula.

settings.label: Buying with us
settings.question: How quickly do orders ship, and can I track them?
settings.answer: Orders leave us in 1–2 business days and most arrive within 5–7. You'll get a tracking number by email as soon as your parcel is on its way — and shipping is free on every order, with no minimum spend.

settings.label: Buying with us
settings.question: Is my payment and personal information safe?
settings.answer: Checkout is encrypted end to end and handled by Shopify Payments, so we never see or store your card details. We use your email to send order updates and, only if you ask for them, occasional notes about new products. We never sell your data.

settings.heading: The Things People Ask Us Most
settings.description: Who we are, how we make things, and what happens if a product isn't right for you — answered plainly, with nothing buried in the fine print.
settings.support_text: Send us your question and a real person answers within one business day — no bots, no scripts.
